About Us

A Christian humanitarian organization serving with compassion and dignity.

Kingdom Path Society exists to walk with refugees, displaced families, newcomers, and vulnerable communities through practical care, faithful service, and meaningful connection.

Mission

To serve refugees, displaced families, newcomers, and vulnerable communities with compassion, dignity, faith, and practical support.

Vision

A community where every refugee and vulnerable family can find safety, hope, belonging, and a new beginning.

Our Values

Faithful service shaped by care.

Our values guide how we listen, serve, partner, and support families during moments of transition and need.

Compassion

Dignity

Faithful service

Respect

Practical support

Community partnership

How We Serve

A steady path of welcome, support, and hope.

Listen

We begin with respectful listening so families can share needs, concerns, and goals.

Coordinate

We connect people with practical resources, volunteers, partners, and community support.

Walk Alongside

We offer ongoing encouragement as families build stability, belonging, and a new beginning.
